a: पाखंडः — A heretic; पाखंडचंडालयोः पापारंभकयोर्मृगीव वृकयोर्भीरुर्गता गोचरं Māl. 5. 24; दुरात्मन् पाखंडचंडाल Māl. 5.

s: puM, (pAtIti । pA + kvip । pAstrayIDarmmastaM KaRqayatIti । Kaqi Bedane + pacAdyac । yaduktam । “pAlanAcca trayIDarmmaH pASabdena nigadyate । taM KaRqayanti te yasmAt pAKaRqAstena hetnA । nAnAvrataDarA nAnAveSAH pAKaRqino matAH ॥”) pAzaRqaH । ityamarawIkAyAM BAnudIkzitaH ॥
v: tri॰ “pAlanAcca trayIDarmaH pASabdema nigadyataM” ityukteH pAtrIti pA--kvip pAH trayIDarmaH taM KaRqayati KaRqi--aR upa॰ sa॰ । pAzaRqe sarvaliNgini amarawAkAyAM BAnudIkzitaH । mUrdDanyazasaDyaH sarvasamammataH ।
m: पाखण्ड m. = (and prob. only w.r. for) पाषण्ड, q.v.
